notes: Both cola 'all ye X': the supplied 'ye' stands immediately before the vocative noun, not after the imperative, so it is the noun's under rule 36 (cf. 'all ye stars of light'); כֹּל keeps only 'all' (rule 19); the article on אֻמִּים is unrepresented since the ASV writes no 'the' and the vocative 'ye' is the noun's, not the article's.
Volitive 'Oh' joins הַלְלוּ under rule 17, headed on 'praise'; object marker unrepresented under rule 16.
